subject: Data sovereignty premium & geo-tiering question — FinovateX
messages:
From: Kate Reynolds <kate@finovatex.com>
To: dylan.brooks@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-28T14:23:00Z
Subject: Pricing & residency for upcoming pilot

Hi Dylan,

Thanks again for the demo earlier this week — FinovateX is keen to run a 3-month pilot for our customer support summarization pipeline. Before we pull legal and procurement in, can you send baseline hosted API pricing and clarify the EU data residency option? A couple of specific asks: 

- Baseline per-token rates for text generation and embeddings (we expect ~100M tokens/month during peak).
- Is there an explicit "EU residency" add-on (i.e., run inference + logs in EU region only)? If so, how is it priced — flat adder, % uplift, or per-GB storage?
- Can we route only certain routes (e.g., /summarize) to EU and keep others on US for cost reasons, or does residency require full-account residency?

We have a target pilot budget of roughly $10k/month to start; if that helps with any tiered pricing guidance. We may want a quote for both pay-as-you-go and committed options.

Appreciate a short summary we can forward to procurement.

Best,
Kate
Kate Reynolds
Head of Platform Partnerships — FinovateX

[Attachment: FinovateX_Route_Specs.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)]
From: dylan.brooks@redwood.ai
To: Kate Reynolds <kate@finovatex.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-29T09:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Pricing & residency for upcoming pilot

Kate — thanks, great questions. High level answers first, then a couple of options depending on commitment: 

Summary (one-liner): Hosted API base rates are charged per 1k tokens; EU data-residency is available as a regional premium that can be scoped per-route via routing policies (so you can keep non-sensitive routes in the US), and we can offer a committed discount in exchange for monthly minimums.

Details: 
- Base (US) hosted API rates (public):
  • Text generation (model X-large): $0.95 / 1k prompt tokens, $2.40 / 1k completion tokens
  • Embeddings: $0.20 / 1k vectors (128-dimension equivalent)
- EU Residency options:
  • Regional Premium (EU residency adder): +12% of base token charges OR a fixed adder of $0.12 / 1k tokens — we can price either way depending on your preference for predictability.
  • Storage of logs/audit trails in EU: charged at $0.10 / GB-month.
- Route scoping: Supported. You can define per-route policies so only /summarize routes hit EU capacity; other requests remain on US endpoints (and billed at the region where inference runs).
- Multi-region routing fee: a small monthly routing coordination fee ($500/mo) applies when you span both regions to cover replication and cross-region metrics; this fee can be waived for the first quarter on committed buys.
- Commit discounts (applied to base charges before residency adder):
  • 3-month commit $30k total: 8% discount
  • 6-month commit $75k total: 12% discount
  • 12-month commit $180k total: 20% discount

I've attached our public ratecard for completeness and included a simple worked example in the attachment that maps your ~100M token scenario to US vs EU cost. If you prefer, I can produce a one-page quote (line items + suggested concession) for procurement.

Attachment: Redwood_Public_Ratecard_Oct2026.pdf (ratecard stub)

Next steps: If you can share expected token mix (prompt vs completion, embeddings volume) and whether logs must remain in EU, I’ll run a quick committed vs PAYG comparison for you.

— Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Kate Reynolds <kate@finovatex.com>
To: dylan.brooks@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-01T08:47:00Z
Subject: Re: Pricing & residency for upcoming pilot

Thanks Dylan — that helps. A couple of clarifications from procurement: 

- Token mix: approx 30% prompt / 70% completion. Embeddings will be low at first (test set ~50k vectors).
- Logs: for the pilot, we need inference logs and audit trails kept in EU for customer data residency.
- Routing: we'd like to route only /summarize and /escalation to EU. Latency from EU users is important.

Could you send the one-page quote you mentioned (PAYG vs 6-month commit) and call out: effective per-1k cost for our expected mix, residency uplift, and any waived fees for the pilot. Procurement would also like to see the SOW template for a pilot (timeline + acceptance).

Kate

[Forwarded message included below]
From: dylan.brooks@redwood.ai
To: Kate Reynolds <kate@finovatex.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-02T10:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Pricing & residency for upcoming pilot

Kate — attaching a short quote and a draft SOW for the pilot. Key lines called out below so procurement can scan quickly: 

- PAYG (estimate for your 100M tokens / month, 30/70 split):
  • Base charges (US): $0.95 * 30k + $2.40 * 70k per 1k token buckets => effective blended base: $1.98 / 1k tokens => ~$198k for 100M tokens (PAYG) — this is illustrative; attached sheet breaks down numbers.
  • EU residency adder (12%): +$23.76k => total ~ $221.8k for 100M tokens (PAYG)
- 6-month commit (recommended for pilot-to-scale):
  • 12% commit discount on base => base reduced to ~$174k/month equivalent for 100M tokens; residency adder applied after discount = +$20.9k => net ~$195k/mo equivalent.
- Pilot concession: waive the $500/mo multi-region routing fee for first 3 months if you sign a 6-month commit.

Attachments: FX_SOW_draft_v1.docx (SOW stub), FinovateX_Route_Specs.xlsx (your original), Redwood_Public_Ratecard_Oct2026.pdf

Marissa / Rishi / Neha — looping you in for pricing approval on the 12% adder and the suggested 3-month routing-waive concession. If approved, I’ll convert this to an official one-page quote and hand to procurement.

— Dylan
